sample_unit: individuals assessed by the risk model
models_evaluated: logistic regression autoimmune disease risk model (positive ANA)

links.outcome: Technical failures of laboratory input data pipeline preventing the CDS alert from firing
links.effect: Laboratory vendor change, a broken lab machine, and a lab test name change prevented the alert from firing; 3,961 assessed, 2,105 randomized.
links.quote: Technical challenges that prevented the custom CDS alert from firing included an unanticipated change in the laboratory testing vendor and reporting due to a broken laboratory machine, followed by a change in the laboratory test name.

unlisted_practices: Close collaboration with the laboratory team and understanding of laboratory workflow and reporting when building laboratory-based CDS alerts
Using a silent background CDS alert for research randomization

screen.reason: Case report describing the implementation and technical barriers of integrating a live EHR predictive risk model into clinical decision support workflows for pragmatic trial randomization.
